title: OPT GPTQ model export accuracy validation failed in PyTorch LLM tests
signature: accuracy validation failed assertionerror in test export model precommit opt gptq katuni4ka|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_export_model_precommit[CPU-opt_gptq-katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq] failed with AssertionError: Accuracy validation failed

key_errors: fw_re and ov_res logit values differ beyond tolerance in OPT GPTQ 4-bit model export
root_cause: The OPT GPTQ model (katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq, 4-bit quantized via GPT-QModel) fails accuracy validation when exported via OpenVINO. The maximum output difference between the PyTorch (TorchFusedQuantLinear kernel) and the OV-converted model reaches 0.069, which exceeds the test's acceptance threshold. This is a deterministic failure: the model was loaded with GPT-QModel 6.0.3 / Torch 2.12.0+cpu and the conversion produced a numerically divergent result. The divergence likely originates from numerical precision differences in the 4-bit dequantization path between TorchFusedQuantLinear and the OpenVINO runtime's handling of GPTQ weights.
recommended_actions: Investigate the GPTQ 4-bit weight dequantization path in the PyTorch FX frontend for accuracy regressions
Compare dequantized weight values between TorchFusedQuantLinear and the OV runtime output
Check recent commits touching src/frontends/pytorch or GPTQ/AWQ quantization handling
Review tolerance thresholds in compare_results for GPTQ quantized models
If tolerance is correct, bisect recent commits to find the regression
prevention_strategies: Add a dedicated precommit accuracy test for GPTQ model exports that runs on every PR touching the PyTorch frontend or quantization code paths, with tight diff tolerances to catch regressions early.
historical_context: First occurrence of this specific accuracy validation failure for OPT GPTQ export. Prior investigations for the same run (30331659250) lacked log access and were incorrectly classified as Flaky Test.
